behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Deferred high-priority item does not block ready items; equal priority retains insertion order after edits.
Snapshot restore preserves sequence gaps and invalid restore leaves state intact.
docDelivery: Readiness boundary, priority/sequence ordering and ID reuse rules.
Detached snapshot schema, nextSequence gaps and atomic validation.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Unique pending nonempty ASCII IDs; priority integer -10..10; readyAt/now integer0..1e12; safe sequence increments. Ordinary acyclic JSON payloads without custom methods/getters/undefined/symbols/nonfinite/-0. Snapshot exact fields and item shape; invalid sequence, duplicate IDs or priority/time bounds included.
independence: Implement priority/deferred item transitions and stable export/import without losing insertion sequence.
